description.narrative: The LDCF was established in response to guidance received from the seventh Conference of the Parties (COP 7) to the United Nations Framework Convention on Climate Change (UNFCCC) in 2001. It is a fund established under the Global Environment Facility and focuses on climate adaptation in least developed countries. LDCF has a strategy for 2022-2026. For this strategy period (GEF-8), LDCF has four thematic priorities: 1) Agriculture, food security, and health; 2) Water; 3) Nature-based solutions; and 4) Early Warning and Climate Information Systems. The support is to be provided for the last three years of the strategic period.
